scope: pinned public Boltons v2 scripted QEMU/HVF recovery experiment
interpretation: Three full-VM journal saves were avoided, but this run was slower end to end; an earlier paired run had the opposite timing sign. No reliable episode-throughput gain is established.
boundaries: This is a solved public integration fixture, not held-out agent evaluation.
The crashed process was QEMU; the host adapter/coordinator remained alive.
The inspector is trusted-tool and guest-probe based, not eBPF/ZFS/CRIU.
No model inference, optimizer, GPU training, or host power-loss test was included.
